_note: Verify each 'model' string against the provider's current model list before running -- these are placeholders and model IDs change independently of this config. Never put an API key value in this file; apiKeyEnvVar names the environment variable to read it from.
_note_maxTokens: 8192 was empirically confirmed too small 2026-08-01: every capability-synthesis and reduce call in the first building test run hit it and was silently truncated (fixed now to fail closed instead -- see llm-adapter.ts's stop_reason/finishReason checks and synthesis-orchestrator.ts's splitMarkedFiles). Raised to 16384 as a first re-tested guess, not a verified ceiling -- if a future call still throws LLM_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED, raise further and re-test rather than assuming this value is enough for every call shape.
_note_gemini: Gemini runs via Vertex AI (not the consumer Generative Language API), authenticated with ADC ('gcloud auth application-default login') rather than an API key -- reflects SSO/enterprise access, no apiKeyEnvVar needed or used for this provider. projectId/location verified working 2026-08-01 against dev-oskey-io under identity david.openshaw@oskey.io. Region matters for MODEL AVAILABILITY, not just uptime -- confirmed 2026-08-11 that europe-west1 only serves the 2.5 generation while us-central1 (and the 'global' endpoint) already serve 3.x models on this same project/identity. Check with a free ai.models.list() call before assuming a model doesn't exist just because one region 404s it.

gemini-default._note: 2026-08-11: CONFIRMED WORKING via a real generateContent call (module 'tasks', both capability-synthesis and connective-tissue calls succeeded end to end). us-central1 showed gemini-3.5-flash as catalog-visible (ai.models.list()/.get()) but generateContent 404'd there -- catalog visibility is NOT the same as generation entitlement per-region. 'global' has both catalog visibility AND real generation access for this model on this project/identity. If adding another 3.x model, verify generateContent specifically (not just .get()/.list()) before trusting it, and prefer 'global' over a specific region for the newer generation until region-by-region entitlement is otherwise confirmed.

gemini-default-temp0._note: 2026-08-29: same model/project/region as gemini-default, temperature dropped to 0.0. Added to test two things at once from the full-repo simulation run: (1) whether temp 0 reduces the run-to-run citation-density/finding-selection variance confirmed real on gemini-default (-42.9%/+36.4% and -29%/+86% swings across two independent same-facts diffs), and (2) a full-scale (~74 real calls) stress test of the retry-with-timeout fix added to llm-adapter.ts the same day. Deliberately excludes 'seed' -- that param isn't wired through llm-adapter.ts yet and isn't needed to answer either question above; add it separately if a strict same-seed repeatability test becomes worthwhile. Must be run with COMPARISON_MODE=true against an existing runId to avoid overwriting that run's canonical gemini-default (temp 0.2) output, which is the baseline this is compared against.

gemini-default-temp0-run2._note: 2026-08-29: identical to gemini-default-temp0 in every respect (same model/project/region/temperature 0.0) -- exists purely so its own distinct LLM_CONFIG_KEY gives it a separate COMPARISON_MODE output path (llm-comparison/gemini-default-temp0-run2/) rather than overwriting gemini-default-temp0's first-pass output. Purpose: the real reproducibility test is temp0-run1 vs temp0-run2 diffed against EACH OTHER, not either one against the temp 0.2 baseline -- comparing against 0.2 just shows two different sampling strategies produce different output, which was never in question and doesn't test whether temp 0 itself is more self-consistent.

gemini-default-highthinking._note: 2026-08-11: same model/project/region as gemini-default, but adds thinkingLevel: HIGH (@google/genai's ThinkingConfig -- Gemini's equivalent of Claude's adaptive-thinking effort control). Added specifically for 01c-generate-assembly-first-profile.ts's connective-tissue call -- the one place a real quality gap showed up (thinner cross-capability judgment in Sections 12/13 vs Claude on the same `building` facts), not for the cheap per-capability calls in 01a, which were already fine at the default thinking level. Point LLM_CONFIG_KEY at THIS key only for 01c, keep 01a on plain 'gemini-default' -- don't pay for extra thinking on calls that didn't show the gap. Not yet validated with a real call.

gemini-default-v1ab-old-canonical._note: 2026-08-30: identical to gemini-default. One-off fix for the V1-A/V1-B factorial experiment: `organization_intercom_ communication`'s real canonical capability-synthesis output was regenerated under the NEW (2026-08-30) capability contract during V1-A's own verification (17e), contaminating the 'old contract' baseline for the organization module (13 of its 14 packs are still genuinely old-contract, dated 2026-08-29; this one isn't). This key produces one fresh OLD-contract regeneration of just that pack (via CAPABILITY_CONTRACT_PATHS_OVERRIDE pointed at 00-capability-synthesis.OLD.md) so a clean, fully-old-contract capability-syntheses set exists for the experiment's 'Current'/'B' arms, built by combining this one regenerated file with copies of the other 18 already-old-contract canonical files across tasks/apps/organization.

gemini-default-v1ab-cap-run1._note: 2026-08-30: identical to gemini-default in every respect. claude-default._note: No 'temperature' here deliberately -- claude-sonnet-5 rejects the request outright if it's present at all (HTTP 400 'temperature is deprecated for this model'), confirmed 2026-08-01. The adapter omits it entirely for Anthropic; leaving a value here would misleadingly imply it's respected.
